title: In-Person Appointments Booking Eligibility: Lead Time, Horizon, Visit Type, Referrals and Authorizations
content:
## Clauses

These clauses decide whether an In-Person Appointments visit may be booked, and on which slot.

**(a) Slot timing.** A visit is booked on a slot whose start is at least the visit type's minimum lead in hours after the moment of booking and no later than the visit type's booking horizon in days after the booking date. A same-day slot is booked only where the visit type allows same-day booking.

**(b) Visit type follows history.** A patient with no completed visit in the department within the new-patient look-back books a New Patient Office Visit; otherwise the patient books an Established Patient Office Visit.

**(c) Referral on the Commercial HMO/EPO Account tier.** When the patient's billing account is on the Commercial HMO/EPO Account tier and the visit type requires a referral on that tier, the visit must be booked against a referral. The linked referral is approved, is for the department of the visit, has units remaining, and its valid-through date is on or after the scheduled date. These four points are read from the referral's system record before the booking, for the referral the visit is booked against.

**(d) Prior authorization.** Where the visit type requires prior authorization and the patient is insured, the linked authorization must meet the same four points and be approved at least the visit type's authorization lead in business days (Monday to Friday, group holidays excluded) before the scheduled date; if it is not, the clinic moves the visit, as a clinic-initiated reschedule, rather than letting it proceed unauthorized.

**(e) Self-pay.** Self-pay patients need no referral or authorization.

**(f) Restricted and dismissed patients.** A patient under the same-day-only restriction of the attendance rules may book only a slot on the handling date itself. A patient who has been dismissed from the practice is not booked; a request to reverse a dismissal is not something the booking rules decide.

**(g) Channel and slot.** Online self-booking is available only for visit types that allow MyLinden self-scheduling; the others are booked by phone or at the front desk. Each visit occupies one slot of the visit type's slot length.

## Referral check, condition by condition

| Point read from the referral record | Satisfied when |
|---|---|
| Status | Approved |
| Department | The same department as the visit |
| Units | At least one unit remaining |
| Valid-through date | On or after the scheduled date (the scheduled date itself qualifies) |

All four must hold; a referral failing any one of them does not cover the visit.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- A Commercial HMO/EPO Account patient books a Specialist Consultation for 2026-11-12 against an approved referral for that department with 2 units left and a valid-through date of 2026-11-12: covered. The same referral with a valid-through date of 2026-11-11: not covered.
- An In-Office Procedure Visit for an insured patient, with an authorization lead of 3 business days: an authorization approved 3 business days before the scheduled date meets the lead; one approved only 2 business days before does not, and the clinic moves the visit.
- A self-pay patient books an Advanced Imaging Appointment: no referral or authorization is needed.
